invented_facts: The 128 GB configuration 'matched and exceeded competitor speeds on those same models': the paper reports its result for the 30B model, not the 8B model.
The base configuration was 'throttled' to 6 tokens per second: the paper attributes that result to the model not fitting entirely in fast memory, not throttling.
'Competitors with larger, faster GPUs dominate this workload' generalizes a result measured for one competing configuration.
notes: The summary is within the word limit and has three bullets, but it omits required test conditions and caveats, including the three-unit sample, the single Vantage configuration, 4-bit quantization and unevaluated output quality. It also fails to distinguish the continuous 8B thermal test from the battery inference test and omits the video-playback conditions behind the battery rating.
